item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This was the most interesting this story got to be, and I say it does have potential. But still, not only does the narrative have a very broken flow during the dream-sequence, Bobble wasn't the best villain for such a physical confrontation.

You should really work it more, those tales do have some promise to them if you flesh out the narrative and the character presentation and development. And if you want to make the clown the foe here, change the physical confrontation for something more in line with Bobble's usual modus-operandi. It shouldn't even hint to Bobble existing outside of electronic media.

Also, it was pretty weird to think that after she ignored the egg during the events at the Red Pool, she used it just because of a knife.
